name: simple-house-planner
description: Design houses, floor plans and room layouts in ChatGPT and change them by hand: to scale in 2D and 3D, with furniture, gardens and building calculators, stored in your Simple House Planner account.

interface.longDescription:
Simple House Planner designs houses, apartments and rooms with you, to scale, and shows them beside the chat in 2D and 3D.

Describe the home you want, such as a three-bedroom farmhouse, a small cabin, an apartment layout or a new kitchen, and ChatGPT draws the floor plan floor by floor: walls, doors, windows, stairs, roofs, furniture, the garden and the site. The planner checks each step for what you would notice walking through it, such as furniture in the way through a door or a room no door reaches, and ChatGPT fixes it.

The editor opens beside the conversation with the same controls as the website. Move a wall, furnish a room or walk through the house in 3D by hand, and ChatGPT sees your change on its next turn. Your plans are stored in your account, so they also open at simplehouseplanner.com, where you can export them as PDF sheets to scale, DXF, DWG and IFC.

Ask about a build and ChatGPT calculates it, without sign-in: how many stairs you need, square footage, flooring, paint, drywall, concrete, gravel, a deck, a fence, roofing, insulation, a ramp, window sizes and the bed, sofa, table or rug that fits a room.

Plans are design aids and do not replace the work of an architect or a check against local building rules.
defaultPrompt: Design a three-bedroom farmhouse floor plan with a porch.
Lay out my 4 by 5 meter living room with a sofa and a dining table.
How many stairs do I need for a 2.8 meter floor height?

positive.description: Design a house from a brief
positive.prompt: Design a one-floor house of about 90 square meters with two bedrooms, an open kitchen and a gable roof, in Freiburg.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a plan, opens the editor beside the chat, builds walls, rooms, doors, windows and a roof, reads the warnings, fixes them, and describes the finished rooms with their areas.

positive.description: Change a plan and take it back
positive.prompt: Add a 4 by 6 meter garage to the east side of the family house. Then undo that.
positive.expected_behavior: Adds the garage with a garage door, reports the change, then removes it again with undo_change and says that the garage is gone.

positive.prompt: Furnish the master bedroom of the family house with a double bed and two wardrobes.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the room, places a double bed and two wardrobes from the catalog against its walls, and reports any clearance warning that remains.

positive.prompt: Check the family house against barrier-free rules and tell me what to change. Do not change anything yet.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the findings of the DIN 18040-2 check in plain words with proposed fixes, says that the checks are design aids, and makes no change.

positive.description: Answer a building question with a calculator
positive.prompt: How many stairs do I need for a floor-to-floor height of 2.8 meters? Use the German stair rule.
positive.expected_behavior: Calls calculate_stairs without sign-in and gives the number of risers, the riser height, the tread depth and the total run, and says whether DIN 18065 is met.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon.

negative.description: A legal guarantee the plugin cannot give
negative.prompt: Confirm that my plan is approved by the building authority so that I can start building.

negative.description: Destructive request without a named plan

publication.release_notes: Building calculators in the chat, without sign-in: stairs, square footage, flooring, paint, drywall, concrete, gravel, deck, fence, roofing, insulation, ramps, window sizes and furniture sizes. Clearer tool descriptions, so ChatGPT finds the right tool for house plans, floor plans and room layouts.
